fault.public_observation_readback: 7D target_pose field from post-step state observation only once immediately following injected arm hold; no private getter
fault.oracle_scope: privileged target controller private memory for reference only

scientific_scope: Two third-party frozen PPO checkpoints and only one Panda root-frame target controller implementation. Fault simulated as a substituted no-op arm command, not physical packet loss.
